high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the Malayalam movie "Hridaya Poorvam," directed by Sathyan Anthikad. The poster features a man in the foreground wearing a blue shirt, with two women standing behind him. The man appears to be looking off to the side with a thoughtful expression, while the women behind him look serious. The background of the poster is a warm yellow color, giving it a nostalgic and vintage feel. There are illustrations of buildings, including a prominent tower on the left and another structure on the right, suggesting an urban setting.
